[{"id": "nnvMTG5Sl5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🛠️ Operations Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "B-CtTCmVDX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The operations module contains features related to the operation of the church (maintenance, assets, etc).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "w8oEjl0tNc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "📦Assets", "col": 12}}, {"id": "6IlcMu_Ikb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Property of the church.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0J08Yp0qsz", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a new asset, note the following:
- Try to give the asset a short but descriptive title
- Additional details can be added in the 'Notes' field
- The location of the asset can be set (or added) in the \"Location\" field.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "SxmzzpDQ__", "type": "header", "data": {"text": "📍 Location", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ppmgXY62eA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A location is any physical or virtual space where something can reside.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Zy36TCqTow", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a new location, note the following:
- Locations can be set as a 'group'. This will allow other locations to be 'grouped' under this location.
- Locations can be linked to an address. When linked, the map moves to the address. An address that is not on the map yet is looked up first, unless 'Look Up Addresses for the Map' is clear in People Settings. Then place the pin by hand.
- Shapes/drawings can be added to the map view for reference purposes (i.e. circle an area in an open space)", "col": 12}}, {"id": "8zFlGyC4XI", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "✅Tasks", "col": 12}}, {"id": "kDsKUF3xl2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Items that need to be completed. (Like a checklist or todo-list)", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t5oHSN8It-", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a new task, note the following:
- To add sub-tasks, check the 'Is Group' option, then create new tasks and select the 'group' task in the 'Parent Task' field.
- ⚠️ Assigning a person is only for documentation purposes, no additional 'reminder' or 'notification' functionality exists yet.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "mm_h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "📝Meeting Minutes", "col": 12}}, {"id": "mm_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Meeting Minutes record board or committee meetings.
- Optionally link the related Function.
- List who was present in the 'Attendees' table and write the record in the 'Minutes' field.
- Set 'Approved On' once the minutes are approved.
- If the meeting was recorded, attach the audio file in the 'Recording' section. It can be played back from the form.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "room_h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🚪Rooms", "col": 12}}, {"id": "room_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Room is a space that people can book, such as the sanctuary, a classroom or the fellowship hall. Tick Bookable to let people book it. Tick Requires Approval when a Church Manager must approve each booking.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "room_book_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To book a room, add a Room Booking, or click Book a Room on a Function. Note the following:
- The Room list shows only rooms with Bookable ticked. A booking of any other room is refused.
- On a room that does not require approval, a new booking is Approved at once. On a room with Requires Approval ticked, a new booking stays Requested until a Church Manager approves it.
- If a user who is not a Church Manager changes the room, the start or the end of an approved booking, the booking goes back to Requested and waits for approval again. A change to the notes only keeps it Approved.
- Two bookings of one room cannot overlap. When a booking clashes, the message names the clashing bookings of your churches. It counts the bookings of other churches, but does not name them.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "room_church_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Rooms with more than one church. A room belongs to one church, and only that church can book it. Tick Shared with all churches on a room to let every church book it. A shared room has one diary for every church, so every church sees its bookings and a booking blocks that time for all of them. The Requester of a booking must be a person of the church that books the room.", "col": 12}}]
